name: Charm Person
summary: A Humanoid fails a Wisdom save and is Charmed by you and Friendly for 1 hour, or until harmed.
text: One Humanoid you can see within range makes a Wisdom saving throw, with Advantage if you or your allies are fighting it. On a failure it has the Charmed condition for 1 hour, ending early if you or your allies damage it, and it is Friendly toward you while Charmed. When the spell ends, the creature knows you charmed it. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: you can target one more creature for each slot level above 1.
